text_block_list.text:
With eyes set on spring glory,
the grueling days of training continued, starting with the prep race, the Nikkei Sho.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haa..., haa..., haa...!
choice_data_list: Pick up the pace at this exact moment!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ghk, yes—! Hyaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A normobaric hypoxic chamber... Hehe.
It reminds me of my mountain climb last year.
choice_data_list: No signs of illness or anything?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm fine. You could even lower the oxygen concentration a bit more—just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Puha, haah, haah—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, whew...—
...Yeah. I was able to dive deeper than yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Before our break... would it be all right
if I swam just a little bit more?
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll calculate the workload and figure out the distance now.

text_block_list.text:
Her dedication
gradually began to inspire those around her—

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or's really been putting in the work lately.
Her whole vibe feels sharper, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her expression's sharpened up quite a bit, too, hasn't it?
Man, it really makes you want to cheer for her.
Focusing on stamina training, they piled on various workouts—and then, for the finishing touch...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Joint training with all of us?! Sounds awesome, let's do it!
To inspire and elevate one another through practical training, we organized a joint training session.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan and I will be taking on overseas challenges soon, after all.
For the sake of honing our skills, we'd love to join.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Besides... I am well aware that you are undertaking a major challenge.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Since we're classmates from the same year, please allow me to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My—thank you so much,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――! Your time... is right here. If you focus on your center of gravity in the second half,
it looks like you can shave off a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I shall go once more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This is so hard...!
But I've still got plenty more to give!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whew! My legs are burning!
All right! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Refreshments for everyone~♪
Here's some refreshing Hachimii from Maru-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
I was just so exhausted. This is sure to soothe me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Still, it was a wonderful day, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Right! Running together really is great.
It just sets your heart ablaze!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: âLoves-chan and the others are going overseas for the first time, Bouquet-san has the pinnacle of long-distance races, and I have my first middle-distance Gâ  too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Let's all overcome our walls
and stretch out 10,000 miles! Let's grow big!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That's right.
...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... *exhale*—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah. My body feels light.
I've done everything I possibly can.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(First, today,
I must claim the flower that connects to the spring Chrysanthemum—!)
The Nikkei Sho is about to begin!
